correctness.rationale: The incidence graph of W(2,2) has 15 points plus 15 totally isotropic lines from nondegenerate alternating F2^4, 30 vertices/45 edges, valency 3, diameter 4 and girth 8. In the precise visible-robber alternating game with stationary moves, the recurrence F_{t+1}(C)=support(C) union over simultaneous cop moves C′ of (support(C′) union {r:N[r] subset F_t(C′)}) follows from the existential cop and universal robber move quantifiers. The source package implements both this winning recurrence and its complementary robber-survival recurrence. An independent newly coded Python exact bitset exhaustive solver checked all k=1,2,3 cop multisets and 30 robber positions, obtaining k1 counts [30,120,120,120], k2 [900,3420,3420,3420], k3 [13950,50520,55080,75360] and exactly 70 three-turn-optimal placements. The independently computed 70-line canonical list SHA256 matches 422e6ea22043c57643838985dc011c76221708a837c123f32282bb65c4d9353d; geometric classification 35 F2 projective point-lines, 15 line pencils, 20 reguli holds exactly. Radius-two balls of size ten overlap pairwise by diameter four, so any three cannot cover 30 starting sites in two moves, giving a separate lower bound. Stabilized losing sets for 1 and 2 cops establish cop number 3. This is an exhaustive finite proof for the 30-vertex graph, not an extrapolation.
residual_risks: Precise game moves matter: visible robber, cops move first, pass allowed, 30-vertex incidence graph not 15-vertex GQ point graph. No theorem for general cages or generalized quadrangles.
